_doc: Search everywhere it helps (docs/SEARCH.md; ItemSearch, SearchIndex, SearchBar). from_items: a list shows its search field from this many things. least_letters: a shorter query matches word starts only. typo_from: words this long may be one letter off. recent_kept: recent searches kept per menu. kind_words: more words for each catalog kind (locale keys: a space-separated list). chips: per menu, filters shown under the field: face (a card face's field that must be true) or kinds (catalog kinds, any of).
